real_world_prompts.prompt: Build a CRM with login, contacts, dashboard, role-based access, and premium plan with payments. Admins can see analytics.
Create an e-commerce store with product listings, shopping cart, checkout with Stripe payments, user accounts, and an admin panel for managing inventory.
Build a project management tool with task boards, team collaboration, file sharing, time tracking, and Gantt charts.
Create a social media dashboard with post scheduling, analytics, multi-account management, and engagement tracking.
Build a healthcare appointment system with patient portals, doctor schedules, video consultations, and prescription management.
Create a learning management system with course creation, student enrollment, quizzes, progress tracking, and certificates.
Build a real estate platform with property listings, map search, agent profiles, mortgage calculator, and virtual tours.
Create a food delivery app with restaurant menus, order tracking, delivery management, ratings, and payment integration.
Build a customer support ticketing system with ticket routing, knowledge base, live chat, SLA management, and reporting.
Create a fitness tracking app with workout plans, nutrition logging, progress photos, social challenges, and wearable integration.
